name: superglue
long_description:
superglue is a platform for ERP implementation teams at VARs, advisory firms and systems integrators. Each client implementation is a project in superglue, and its AI agents do the hands-on work across the whole project: the project plan from the kickoff, data assessment, fit-gap, configuration, data mapping and migration, testing, cutover and the integrations that run after go-live.

The agents execute the work in the client's systems, they don't just list what needs doing. Consultants review every change and sign off before anything reaches production. Approved migration scripts run the same way every time, with no AI at run time, and every run is logged.

superglue works with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Acumatica, SAP and about 140 other systems, and reads legacy sources such as QuickBooks Desktop, Sage 50 and 100, Dynamics GP, databases and files.

A Sage value-added reseller running 40 Sage Intacct implementations cut migration and configuration hours per project by 80%. superglue is SOC 2 Type II, offers EU data residency, and can be self-hosted.
one_liner: AI agents that run ERP implementations for consultants
